newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 27.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre sticks to supporting Paris judicial police chief Olivier Foll despite French court's six-month suspension of Foll for refusing police aid to a judge searching the home of the capital's mayor in a corruption probe.
-- Bank Paribas posts a record 1996 profit of 4.35 billion francs, helped by capital gains.
-- French banks struggle to keep up with international competition in financial markets activities.

-- British Aerospace chairman Richard Evans says in an interview that French defence restructuring policy is delaying a re-organisation of Airbus consortium and the European defence industry. Adds he supports Lagardere group in its bid for a privatised Thomson-CSF.

-- Government unwilling to finance car industry restructuring plan involving some 40,000 early retirements if it is not accompanied by an industrial and commercial strategic plan to improve profitability.
